entries.message:
Event Type: Network Upgrade

We are performing system changes in the Atlanta location during the following scheduled maintenance window. 

Start Time: 2026-08-28 04:05:00 UTC
End Time: 2026-08-28 06:05:00 UTC

We have scheduled a 2 hour window, though we expect the work to be much shorter. We have left time in the event that we need to troubleshoot the changes or revert back.  There is no expected impact with the work being done, but felt it was important to let our customers know we are making changes.

We are currently investigating intermittent power loss events affecting one of our Chicago data centers. This may cause unexpected instance reboots or intermittent connectivity loss for a subset of our instance types. Our team is actively working with the facility to identify and resolve the underlying cause. Affected customers do not need to reboot their instances.
